figures.title: Figure 1
figures.llm_description: FIG. 1. Schematic representation of the periodic supercell under study. The structure consists of four BTO nanowires of cross-sectional dimension nW x ¼ nW y ¼ 12 lattice constant units (∼21.4 nm2) separated by 4 lattice constant units and embedded in a Ba0.15Sr0.85TiO3 matrix with lateral sides along the [100] and [010] directions of nx ¼ ny ¼ 32 lattice constant units, and a length nz ¼ 6 along the [001] pseudocubic direction.

figures.title: Figure 2
figures.llm_description: FIG. 2. Microstructure (in-plane component of local modes and defects distribution) for the configurations C1: [þ þ þþ], C2: [−−þ−], C3: [−−þþ], and C4: [−þ þ−] at 5 K. Blue (red) circles denote vortices (antivortices). Dark (light) arrows indicate the dipoles lying in the wires (matrices).

figures.title: Figure 3
figures.llm_description: FIG. 3. (a) Temperature dependence of the inverse in-plane susceptibility χ−1 ⊥corresponding to configuration C10. Vertical arrows indicate the transition temperature at which vortices and antivortices order in the matrix (Tord), and the Curie-Weiss temperature (θCW). Red line is a linear fit of the high temperature values of χ−1 ⊥.
